fixes: Include verified editor-origin root threads in Screen inventory while excluding subagents.
Isolate ambiguous histories and require live /status to select a thread.
Preserve aggregate reports and controller handoff when another session defers its reload.
Wait passively for the controller turn to finish, then reject changed thread/window identity.
Retry the native ownership notice within the reload deadline without bypassing locks.
Patch the SDK Zod dependency without downgrading the SDK.
limits: The controller handoff failed after quitting the old frontend. An October 31 isolated GNU Screen reproduction confirmed that the oversized resume command was silently dropped; nine other session reloads remain verified.
Synthetic stream checks used five-second streams, not the opt-in eleven-minute duration.
Fresh real tool results establish successful continuation at the recorded check time; remote service availability cannot be guaranteed.
